# owner: platform
"""Contact sheet for substitute teachers."""

from typing import Iterable, List

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError


def _validate(roster: List[Student]) -> None:
    if not roster:
        raise ProjectError("no students to list")
    for item in roster:
        if not item.email:
            raise ProjectError(f"no email for {item.display_name}")


def contact_rows(students: Iterable[Student]) -> List[str]:
    """Rows of name, section and email in columns, sorted by name."""
    roster = sorted(students, key=lambda item: item.display_name)
    _validate(roster)
    name_width = max(len(item.display_name) for item in roster)
    sect_width = max(len(item.section) for item in roster)
    return [
        f"{item.display_name:<{name_width}}  {item.section:<{sect_width}}  {item.email}"
        for item in roster
    ]

# owner: platform
import unittest

from rosterkit.models import Student
from rosterkit.errors import ProjectError
from rosterkit.contacts import contact_rows

ADAMS = Student("1", "Adams", "Zoe", "A1", "zoe@example.org")
BAKER = Student("2", "Baker", "Al", "B12", "al@example.org")


class ContactRowTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_rows_are_sorted_and_aligned(self):
        rows = contact_rows([BAKER, ADAMS])
        self.assertEqual(rows[0], "Adams, Zoe  A1   zoe@example.org")
        self.assertEqual(rows[1], "Baker, Al   B12  al@example.org")

    def test_missing_email_names_the_student(self):
        nomail = Student("3", "Cole", "Ann", "A1")
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError) as caught:
            contact_rows([ADAMS, nomail])
        self.assertIn("Cole, Ann", str(caught.exception))

    def test_empty_list_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ProjectError):
            contact_rows([])
